reason: Both are usable and arithmetic is sound, but Output 1 shows sharper commercial judgment — it justifies manual campaigns over Smart+ on a cold pixel, flags that the 55% margin may not include the donated item (which would move every break-even number), gives an operational Shopify-vs-TikTok reconciliation formula, and is fully handoff-ready with owners, a $30k account cap and an approval limit — while Output 2 has an internal threshold conflict ($55 day-10 gate vs its own $45 ceiling) and launches Smart+ on a brand-new pixel without justification.
